author: GamingBolt
description:
In the third part of our recap of the entire Gears of War franchise, we covered the events of Gears of War 3: RAAM's Shadow and Gears of War 1. Here in part 4, we're going to move on to events of Gears of War 2 and Road to Ruin.

Coming off the original's massive success, Epic Games had its work cut out for it. The stakes were made higher and far more personal, and even if the ending left some wanting, there's no denying the sheer scale of the conflict (and the shocking results it would have).

title: The Complete Story of Gears of War 2 - Before You Play Gears of War E-Day (Part 4)

author: GamingBolt
description:
The Witcher 3 Remastered is giving us a fresh new way to experience a journey that’s as iconic as the places it takes us to, and as memorable as the people we meet along the way. Of course, there are some stops on any journey that call to weary travellers more than the others, and The Continent is no different.

We’re headed straight for a few spots with stories that take us to lovely places, or to fight against some nasty opponents, or perhaps give us a new way to approach familiar problems. This one’s about memorable quests that have us curious to see what has changed in the remaster, and it’s a nice, nostalgic trip down memory lane to boot.
title: The Witcher 3 Remastered - 10 Best Quests WE CAN’T WAIT to Revisit

author: GamingBolt
description:
Say what you will about Xbox, but it certainly has a knack for raining on everyone's parade, including its own. Where it should be hyping Gears of War: E-Day like no one's business, especially with how it reportedly cost upwards of $400 million to develop, thus adding another high-profile name to one of the best stretches of gaming in the past several years - and maybe spare some of that marketing budget for Minecraft Dungeons 2 - it's instead gone back to the well and announced layoffs.

Sorry, “eliminations.” This time, it's for Halo Studios, with 268 roles gone, and the once-343 Industries reduced to little more than...something.
title: Xbox Is Destroying Its Own Studios Left and Right - What Is It Even Doing Anymore?
